verdict.rationale: Zero's public GitHub repository describes it as "an open-source AI email solution" and "An Open-Source Gmail Alternative." The README also tells users to open the code in a devcontainer, so the source is readable and published as open source. missing for 10: the specific license (e.g., MIT/AGPL) is never named in the evidence, and there is no independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Zero is an open-source AI email solution that gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
An Open-Source Gmail Alternative for the Future of Email
Then open the code in devcontainer and install the dependencies
